body:
alex: Quick question — for per-key burst enforcement should we do separate token buckets per endpoint (chat/embeddings/rerank/streaming) or a shared bucket with endpoint-specific weights?

maria: my vote is separate buckets. streaming holds long-lived connections and can leak tokens slowly, embeddings are lots of tiny requests. mixing them hurts predictability. :thinking:

kai: separate sounds right but also worried about UX in console + support overhead. customers will ask why their embed traffic is throttled but chat still runs. need clear metrics + alerts.

jen: what about a hybrid? global shared quota for sustained usage + small per-endpoint burst buckets that refill faster but with lower capacity. gives isolation for noisy endpoints but keeps long-term cost control.

alex: that hybrid matches some infra patterns we've used. can we sketch numbers? e.g., per-key monthly token quota, per-endpoint burst = X% of monthly but with min/max slabs.

quota-bot: automated config suggestion v1:
```json
{
  "per_key": {"monthly_tokens": 100000000},
  "endpoint_bursts": {
    "chat": {"burst_tokens": 50000, "refill_seconds": 60},
    "embeddings": {"burst_tokens": 20000, "refill_seconds": 30},
    "rerank": {"burst_tokens": 15000, "refill_seconds": 45},
    "streaming": {"burst_tokens": 100000, "refill_seconds": 300}
  },
  "weights": {"chat": 1.0, "embeddings": 0.2, "rerank": 0.5, "streaming": 0.8}
}
```

maria: I like the refill differences — streaming needs a longer refill window because sessions persist. embeddings should be quick refill since spikes are short.

kai: can we also add an adaptive fallback rule: when endpoint burst exhausted, either throttle or downgrade to cheaper quantized model automatically for some percent of requests? that helps SLAs.

jen: yeah add policy: fallback: {"downgrade_model": true, "max_pct_downgraded": 10, "notify": true}. console should show per-key "burst health" and last-fallback timestamp.

alex: ops questions: how do we surface this in telemetry? we need per-key per-endpoint bucket usage time series, plus events when fallback triggers. also include request-level tag for which bucket was charged.

kai: agree — minimal telemetry: bucket_fill, bucket_drain, fallback_event with reason. build graph panels: 1) realtime drain rate per endpoint 2) monthly consumption vs commit 3) eviction/fallbacks timeline.

jen: action items:
- jen: add schema for hybrid quota (PR) — due EOD Friday
- maria: console wiring for "burst health" panels + tooltip copy — due next Wed
- kai: instrumentation plan (metrics + events) + dashboard sketches — due Mon
- alex: write short API doc explaining semantics + examples for customers — due Tue

alex: sounds good. one more: policy enforcement code should be modular so Dedicated/Private can override refill windows. add that to PR.

maria: noted. I'll add override knobs in UI and a tooltip: "Default refill windows are tuned for hosted workloads; Dedicated customers can customize."

quota-bot: reminder: follow-up meeting suggested: #eng-platform sync on Thurs 11:00 to finalize numbers.

jen: thanks all. keeping the buckets small and fast for embeddings should prevent them from stealing chat/streaming capacity. we'll iterate once we see telemetry. :rocket:
